compositions.title: The right to revise
compositions.html:
FIELD NOTES ON COLLABORATIVE REASONING

The right
to revise

A workspace becomes a place to think when conclusions can move without erasing how people got there.

Keep the landmarks

Leave familiar points of orientation visible. Replacing every panel at once forces the reader to rebuild their mental map, even when the argument has barely changed.

Expose the change

Move closer to an assumption and show the evidence that altered it. A small revision can communicate more than a fresh overview.

Reading room · Editorial composition

compositions.title: Questions in the margin
compositions.html:
ANNOTATION

What changed?

  1. Identify the previous assumption.
  2. Put the new evidence beside it.
  3. Leave a way back to the overview.
Make the revision visible at the scale where it matters.
